notes.title: Version 1.0 Release
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We're thrilled to announce removing Dash Realm from early access and releasing Dash Realm version 1. With this move, we want to let you know that we won't be providing further support or updates for this version.

However, this doesn't necessarily mark the end of Dash Realm's journey. We have some exciting plans in the works, so be sure to stay tuned for upcoming developments with End Realm!


Included in this final update is:

Features:
- full controller support in menus
- tutorial + controls list

QOL:
- add character selection icons
- move End Realm website button to the main menu
- show when no servers are available
- show continue button prompts for the victory screen

Visuals:
- new UI tween animations
- new input icons
- new fonts with more character and readability
- improved menu sprites
- new UI blur effects
- add trails to projectiles
- improve screen shake

Plus various bug fixes and code cleanups!


We're grateful for the support you've shown us thus far, and we're looking forward to working on more projects for you!

notes.title: Making the game free for everyone
notes.content:
Hello fellow gamers,

today we want to announce that we are moving DashRealm to a Free to Play model soon. We made less than 5 sales and as we still think this is a fun game, we would like to make this permanently free to allow more people to enjoy it.

Hope you have a great day :D
